_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Udla Golf (Ludingo lwecadi) - Player {player_id}.
Inhloso: Uthole iskore eliphakeme kulesigamu. Iikolom zinethi inethi, zisuswa kuthiwe zero.
Izithethe zecadi: A=1, 2-10=uthethe, J/Q=10, K=0

Izinto zwenza (sebenzisa brackets ngokulungele):
- '[draw]' - Tola kwindlu
- '[take]' - Thola kwindlu yokudisa
- '[swap X Y]' - Bhalisela icadi elitholiwe na pozishini X (row) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Disa icadi elitholiwe

board.drew:
Wudile: {card}
Noma wuncoma [swap X Y] noma [discard]
board.took:
You took: {card} from discard pile
You must [swap X Y] with it (cannot discard).

options.final_turns: Imizamo yezimali! Zakho zezinto zwenza: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Kumele: [swap X Y] (ungakhoni kulahla emakhadi lasetindvundvumeni)

message.deck_empty: Deck is empty! Game ends immediately.
message.knocked: Umdlali {pid} uyashaywa! Lomunye umdlali utfola litfuba linye.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Umdlali ofanayo unathatha uthatha nanye

invalid.wrong_action: Sebenzisa ngokulungele enye i-akshani ekubhekwe: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], noma [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Awukwazi kulahla likhadi lelisemlonyeni, kufanele ulishintje.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Unendlu yakho. Wuncoma [swap X Y] noma [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kudzingeka kutsi utsatse likhadi lelikhishwe umuntfu kute ukhone kushintja.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kudzingeka ube nelikhadi lelidvwetjelwe kute ulilahle.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Pozishini ngaphandle kwemigomo. Sebenzisa row 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Awungeke ukhone kukhahlela likhadi lelidvwetjelwe. Cedza kucala umsebenti wakho wekukhipha emakhadi.
